units.source_text: "向附近的一位插花女师傅学的。

en.t: I learned it from a nearby female flower-arranging teacher.

units.source_text: 过一会儿，她会到这儿来的。

en.t: She will be coming here in a little while.

units.source_text: 我和她交往，同时向她学习，就这样学会了独自插花，现在我已经腻味了。

en.t: I kept company with her and learned from her at the same time, and that was how I learned to arrange flowers by myself; now I have grown tired of it.

units.source_text: 她是一位年轻漂亮的女师傅哩。

en.t: She is a young and beautiful woman teacher, you know.

units.source_text: 据说，战争期间她同一个军人要好，怀了孕，胎儿是死胎，军人也战死了，后来她就不停地取乐于玩弄男性。

en.t: They say that during the war she was intimate with a soldier and became pregnant; the child was stillborn, and the soldier was killed in battle, and afterward she took constant pleasure in playing with men.

units.source_text: 这女人小有财产，教授插花只是她的一种嗜好罢了。

en.t: This woman has a modest fortune, and teaching flower arrangement is merely one of her hobbies.

units.source_text: 要不，你今晚就带她去逛逛好了。

en.t: Why not take her out somewhere tonight?

units.source_text: 随便上哪儿，她都会去的。"

en.t: Wherever you choose to go, she will go along with you.
